info.name: Verus Companies API
info.description:
Every use case of the Verus Companies API (`/api/v1`), with tests and a saved example response per request.

**Run order matters.** Start the API fresh (`cd backend/src/Verus.Api && dotnet run`) and run the whole
collection: the create requests seed the in-memory store and save `companyId`, and the duplicate (409),
get-by-id, list and search requests depend on that data. Restart the API before running it again, since domains
must be unique.

`baseUrl` defaults to `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`; set it to `https://localhost:7000/api/v1` to use https.
The "Content fallback" request fetches news.ycombinator.com, so it needs internet access.

item.description: POST /companies → **201 Created** with a `Location` header and the company. Each request shows a different relevance rule that links the name to the website. Run the folders in order: later requests use the ids saved here.
